verdict.rationale: There is no documented sandbox or test mode, but there are adjacent ways to experiment safely. Forge (the in-app playground) lets you upload a document and see results without an API key. A free monthly allowance supports a proof of concept, and pipelines are versioned before you 'deploy to production', which implies a pre-production stage. missing for 10: an explicit isolated sandbox/test environment or test API keys, separation of test and production data and jobs, mock or non-billed test calls, and independent corroboration.
